## 2. Six complete procedure selections

All six retain **rank 8, minimum class level 15 and a 21 RP base cost**, with actual repertoire, components, cadence and class features still required.

| Identity | Actual access | Selected complete behavior |
|---|---|---|
| **Deep Crust Spike** | Druid, Mage, Wizard — **Transmutation** | One perceived creature; an actual known solid surface below it; **5d8 fire + 5d8 piercing**, DEX half of each type on success. Explicit 30-foot upward reach and separate caster/origin/body paths. |
| **Molecular Destabilization** | Druid, Mage, Wizard — **Transmutation** | One perceived actual creature; **10d6 force**, CON half on success. Partial dissolution does not silently import Disintegrate, destroy equipment or erase surviving remains. |
| **Soul Pyre** | Cleric, Druid, Wizard — **Necromancy** | One real available principal corpse, selected within 20 feet and consumed atomically at resolution. A separate **20-foot-radius blast** deals **4d6 fire + 4d6 necrotic**, DEX half per type. |
| **Incendiary Cloud** | Mage, Wizard — **Evocation** | Fixed 20-foot-radius field, center within 20 feet; **concentration up to 60 seconds**, with **10d8 fire** at creation and each authorized six-second pulse, DEX half. |
| **Dimensional Break** | Cleric, Mage, Wizard — **Universal** | One perceived designated enemy receives **8d10 force**, DEX half, followed by an independently eligible **CHA exile attempt**. A successful exile uses an expressly extended temporary-cell procedure. |
| **Illusory Wall of Doom** | Wizard — **Illusion** | One visible collapse: **8d6 psychic and actual Prone on INT failure**; half damage and no new Prone on success. Concentration maintains the bounded visual aftermath, not repeated attacks. |

The full procedures include casting, geometry, RNG, defense ordering, damage provenance, conditions, concentration, suppression, endings and actual class access. They appear in both chapters with their complete applicable shared clauses. **The original four B/two C risk classifications remain unchanged.**

## 3. Consequential source conflicts resolved

### Mixed damage preserves both types without doubling the printed dice

**Deep Crust Spike uses ten dice total:** five fire and five piercing. **Soul Pyre uses eight dice total:** four fire and four necrotic. Neither becomes a selectable damage type or automatically doubles to twenty/sixteen dice.

Those splits are expressly **new authoring choices**, not claimed as measurements already printed in the source.

Successful saves halve each type with floor before the actual defense sequence. The selected local mixed-defense rule chooses one applicable strongest competing flat class defense at its real stage. Equal-value ties use a stable source/owner/application order, with exact proportional allocation and deterministic remainder handling.

This adopts the stated convention **only for these two spells**. Meteor’s distinct convention is not rewritten, and Spinal Plating cannot become a second flat reduction or apply to a single-target Spike.

### Soul Pyre consumes real fuel at resolution—not during the counter window

The corpse is selected but **not reserved or consumed by commitment**. The same actual body is revalidated at effect resolution; lawful earlier consumption, resurrection or movement out of range can prevent the paid effect without substitution or refund.

For ordinary Ready, the corpse is selected at release. A countered preparation consumes **no corpse**.

Consumption preserves the body’s provenance as spent ash/char. Its fragments do not become new fuel identities. Real worn/carried items remain real and detach locally; the spell does not erase equipment, claim ownership of a soul or manufacture a recovery entitlement. A focus satisfies the actual component alternative, **not the corpse requirement**.

### Incendiary Cloud actually repeats its damage

The Core “Instantaneous” entry cannot implement the printed per-round benefit by itself. I selected **60 seconds of concentration**, with pulses at:

```text
establishment, +6, +12, +18, +24, +30, +36, +42, +48, +54 seconds
```

Expiry at **+60** wins; there is no final pulse.

A source-specific family record permits one admitted Incendiary Cloud exposure per recipient per numbered round across owners. Save success or immunity after admission still consumes that opportunity; a wholly suppressed or ineligible manifestation does not. Entry, extra turns, companion phases and resumption create **no additional pulse**.

Each pulse creates fresh original-caster recipient roots. An already-created pulse batch completes before its own concentration teardown prevents future pulses. This exception is explicitly local to the cloud; it does not defer unrelated concentration consequences.

### Dimensional Break retains both force damage and exile

Force resolves **first**, including actual damage, life changes and response processing. The same recipient is then rechecked for the independent exile attempt.

Therefore:

- Transport prevention does not erase the force damage.
- Force protection does not automatically cancel exile.
- Redirected damage does not relocate the redirect recipient.
- Actual death can remove the creature prerequisite; living zero HP is not automatically death.

The cell uses the complete named accepted admission/closure contracts through an **explicit new extension**. It preserves actual body, gear, agency and advancing clocks. There is no invented named plane or traversable portal.

The ordinary-Banishment/Break shared primary-cell slot is a **declared reciprocal integration requirement**, not a claim that existing code already enforces it. Actual exile suppression closes the application permanently; blocked physical return uses the accepted placement-conflict behavior rather than leaving an infinite cell.

### The wall retains damage and real Prone

The new bounded geometry is a **60-foot-wide, 30-foot-high image** collapsing through a forward quarter-cylinder. Actual body intersection, a valid line-of-effect witness and actual visual perception govern admission.

**True Seeing identifies the image but does not cancel the wall’s expressly selected independent psychic/balance effect.** This is a wall-specific decision—not an import of Invisible Tide’s nonvisual admission.

Psychic protection and Prone protection remain separate. A failed-save flying recipient without actual support/Hover can begin real Falling; the impact uses the accepted Falling schedule rather than an invented immediate crash.

Standing, disbelief, later dispel and concentration ending do not refund damage or grant a free stand. The aftermath cannot repeatedly knock down a creature that stands.

| Case | Principal worked outcome |
|---|---|
| **RD8-01-A — Spike / mixed defenses** | Fire 27 + piercing 23; actual DR3 allocates 2/1, then fire resistance yields **12 + 22 = 34**. Warrior **105→71 HP**. Successful-save branch takes 15 instead. |
| **RD8-01-B — Spike / airborne body** | Actual Hawk 20 feet above a qualifying floor succeeds on DEX; 20 fire + 20 piercing becomes **10 + 10**, **108→88 HP**. No invented Prone or crash. |
| **RD8-02-A — Molecular / transformed body** | **40 force** consumes Bear’s 20 temporary HP and the Druid’s remaining 20 normal HP. The Wound save succeeds; the same Druid becomes **Dying0**, reverts and receives no restored HP or shift use. |
| **RD8-02-B — Molecular / finite creature** | Actual Corpse Golem at **24/60 HP** takes 41 force: **24 actual HP loss, 17 overkill**, source ends without creating corpse fuel. Its conditional actual-Null branch instead uses its existing NullDisabled behavior. |
| **RD8-03-A — Pyre / corpse and mixed recipients** | One corpse is consumed; shared **15 fire + 17 necrotic**. Caster **108→76**, defended Warrior **105→83**, successful allied save **108→93**. Real gear remains. |
| **RD8-03-B — Pyre / Ready and moving fuel** | A legally carrying ally moves the real corpse before release. The paid hold releases after the actual completed utterance, consuming fuel at its current location. Counterspell and prior Corpse Harvest branches preserve their distinct costs and outcomes. |
| **RD8-04-A — Cloud / repeated damage** | Target HP follows **108→64→44→9→0** through four actual pulses. Caster’s initial self-hit and concentration check are included. Source ending at 19 prevents the +24 pulse. |
| **RD8-04-B — Cloud / overlap and antimagic** | A’s creation deals 40; B cannot repeat that family exposure. Actual local Lesser Antimagic suppresses A’s 6.1 pulse without claiming the new round’s opportunity. After the field ends, B’s 7.1 pulse deals **36** to eligible recipients. |
| **RD8-05-A — Break / both components** | **46 force: 108→62 HP**, then failed CHA establishes the actual temporary cell. The target retains agency. Later occupied-origin closure returns it to the legal adjacent location without healing or resetting its turn. |
| **RD8-05-B — Break / independent prevention** | Actual Dimensional Anchor stops exile but not **46 force**. Branches separately demonstrate CHA success, resistance followed by exile, true death, living Null-zero, real Life Linked transfer and retained hard-control history. |
| **RD8-06-A — Wall / actual True Seeing** | Target identifies the false image, fails INT and takes **29 psychic: 108→79**, maintains True Seeing through its actual concentration save, becomes Prone and later spends real movement to stand. |
| **RD8-06-B — Wall / Prone immunity and Falling** | Actual Ironhorn Ram and Hawk each take **32 psychic**. Ram prevents Prone only. Hawk begins Falling; the actual following-round initiating-slot END supplies the 20-foot step and **1d6 = 4** impact, leaving **72 HP**. |

The cases retain relevant automatic class benefits. **Wizard School Mastery makes the level-15 Evocation/Illusion DC 19**, not 18. A successful actual level-15 Wizard Counterspell pays **56→53 RP**, then Arcane Feedback restores **53→54**. The independent Warrior mixed-defense branches also resolve their actual post-damage BT gain, without retroactively improving the triggering defense.
